shared_elements: figure holding a long staff-like object
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures and one figure in each holds a long staff or pole, plus both include small repeated sign-like units, but these are generic correspondences. A shows sparse, stick-like schematic outlines of figures, boats and discs scattered over an open field, while B shows a dense, ordered double column of intricately modelled glyph blocks on an upright slab with a naturalistically rendered seated man beside it — utterly different depictive conventions and layout.
